AboutPage.headline: 20 years making one thing well.
AboutPage.description: Abstract Man is a men’s underwear manufacturer based in Zhongshan, Guangdong, China. We design, develop, and produce men’s underwear — and only men’s underwear — for brands, retailers, and distributors worldwide.

AboutPage.storyHeadline: From a small workshop to a full-scale facility.
AboutPage.storyP1: We started in 2006 with a small cut-and-sew operation and a clear focus: men’s underwear only. That focus has never changed. Over 20 years we’ve invested in seamless knitting lines, expanded to a 3,000 m² integrated facility, built a team of 100+ specialists, passed a BSCI audit, and completed an SLCP verified assessment.
AboutPage.storyP2: Today we serve brands across 25+ countries — from first-time DTC startups testing 300-piece capsules to global retailers running multi-season programs at 50,000 pieces per order.
AboutPage.m2Event: Expanded to 1,500 m² with cut-and-sew lines
AboutPage.m4Event: Moved to current 3,000 m² facility, 100+ staff
AboutPage.m7Event: ODM design library expanded to 100+ validated styles
AboutPage.valuesHeadline: What we stand behind on every order.
AboutPage.v1Desc: AQL 2.5 on every shipment. Metal detection on every piece. No shortcuts on materials, stitching, or inspection — regardless of order size.
AboutPage.v2Desc: Itemized quotes within 24 hours. Production schedules shared in advance. Photo packs and inspection reports before dispatch. No hidden costs.
AboutPage.v3Desc: 300 pieces or 50,000 — same line, same QC standard. OEM and ODM in the same PO. We adapt to how you work, not the other way around.
AboutPage.v4Desc: 20 years of on-time delivery. Documented workflows at every stage. When we commit to a date, we deliver on that date.
AboutPage.v5Desc: We don’t just fill orders — we develop products. Fabric recommendations, fit improvements, cost engineering. Your success is our repeat business.

FAQPage.headline: Questions brands ask before working with us.
FAQPage.g1A1: 300 pcs per style per color, for both cut-and-sew and seamless. Sampling and launch test runs can be discussed case by case.
FAQPage.g1Q2: Can you handle both small and large volume orders?
FAQPage.g1A2: Yes — from 300-pc test runs to 600,000 pcs per month at full capacity. Scheduling adapts to your order size.
FAQPage.g1A3: Standard payment terms are confirmed during quotation and order placement. For repeat customers or established partnerships, flexible arrangements including LC and net terms may be available.
FAQPage.g2A2: Sampling is charged at cost and typically credited against your first bulk order.
FAQPage.g2Q3: Can you develop from scratch without a tech pack?
FAQPage.g2A3: Yes — that’s our ODM service. Describe the fit, fabric, and target customer, and we develop from our in-house pattern library. ODM projects can go from brief to bulk production in as little as one month.
FAQPage.g3Q1: What fabrics do you work with?
FAQPage.g3A1: Cotton, modal (TENCEL™, MicroModal), bamboo, polyester performance blends, nylon/spandex, and seamless-specific yarns. Custom fabric development is available for sufficient-volume orders.
FAQPage.g3Q2: Do you offer both seamless and cut-and-sew?
FAQPage.g3A2: Yes — both constructions under one roof. Seamless for performance and modern-fit lines; cut-and-sew for classic silhouettes and detailed trims.
FAQPage.g4A1: Yes — woven labels, hang tags, poly bags, printed boxes, and barcode stickers. Send your artwork and we quote packaging alongside the product.
FAQPage.g4Q2: What shipping terms do you support?
FAQPage.g4A2: FOB Nansha or Shenzhen is standard. CIF and DDP available on request. Sea, air, and express all supported.
FAQPage.g4Q3: Can you ship directly to warehouses or fulfillment centers?
FAQPage.g4A3: Yes — including Amazon FBA with FNSKU labeling and FBA-compliant cartons. We also ship to third-party warehouses and distribution centers worldwide.
FAQPage.g5A1: BSCI audit and SLCP verified assessment, renewed annually, plus a Higg FSLM self-assessment. We can also coordinate Sedex, WRAP, or other audits on request.
FAQPage.g5Q2: How do you handle quality control?
FAQPage.g5A2: In-house QC at every stage: inbound fabric, sampling, inline production, and final AQL 2.5 inspection before carton closure. Reports are shared before shipment.
FAQPage.g5Q3: Can you share audit or compliance documents during onboarding?
FAQPage.g5A3: Yes — BSCI audit and SLCP verified assessment documentation is available before you place your first order. We share full audit reports and compliance records as part of standard onboarding.
